scope: Bilingual documentation and two bilingual workflow views. No implementation change, new learning experiment, deployment, or scientific-validation claim.
current_decisions: Learning event chain is EA; learning/work chains cover formation/use, not chain-versus-tree symmetry.
Disambiguate structural merging of a subchain and integration of cached experiences without inventing new formal operators.
Preserve original tool occurrence records before integration; cached content is not automatically true. The same FSM coordinates rest integration.
Document local attention now as a phase-two design: target original plus related upper/lower-index summaries and expandable references. Originals are not replaced by summaries.
Active search first supersedes the earlier passive-first priority at this stage. History and the possibility of later passive supply are retained.
Separate traditional Transformer/traditional agent, the author agent slice, and full logic-memory-FSM empiricism. Full validation cannot be replaced by slice scores.
source_scope: C58 candidate reviewed in full; direct U-1107 confirmations take precedence. Private originals and message identifiers are not published. Candidate T14–T22 observations are attributed and not independently verified.
implementation_check: Inspected public RecallAdapter.readOriginal: fixed raw neighbors; underlying summary-preferred applies to physical paragraph neighbors, not complete related-index composition.

offline_protocol_tests.scope: Existing Hongchenxian synthetic/double and offline-network-guard protocols only.

diagrams.scope: Layout and text/flow consistency, not mechanism or whole-system validation.

release_scan.limits: Heuristic scan, not a guarantee that every secret or rights issue is absent.
